headline: Antique Stock Broking issues a buy rating on a T&D stock despite a 13% drop in 2026
hook: Brokerage backs power equipment amid price dip
summary: Antique Stock Broking has maintained a 'buy' rating on transmission and distribution (T&D) stock Indo Tech Gadgets despite a 13% price decline in 2026. The brokerage has outlined specific target prices, stop losses, and strategic rationales for the recommendation. Retail investors tracking the power sector can evaluate the brokerage's valuation thesis against current market corrections.
why_it_matters: Brokerage target offers perspective on T&D sector valuation drops
winners_losers: T&D stock investors gain clarity / cautious traders wait
